Market Close Report: NASDAQ Composite index closes at 7,328.85 down -28.14 points November 05, 2018, 04:45:26 PM
Monday's session closes with the NASDAQ Composite Index at 7,328.85. The total shares traded for the NASDAQ was over 2.68 billion. Declining stocks led advancers by 1.12 to 1 ratio. There were 1488 advancers and 1667 decliners for the day. On the NASDAQ Stock Exchange 22 stocks reached a 52 week high and 30 those reaching lows totaled. The most active, advancers, decliners, unusual volume and most active by dollar volume can be monitored intraday on the Most Active Stocks page.
The NASDAQ 100 index closed down -.4% for the day; a total of -28.2 points. The current value is 6,937.09. Activision Blizzard, Inc ( ATVI ) had the largest percent change down (-6.74%) while The Kraft Heinz Company ( KHC ) had the largest percent change gain rising 3.27%. The Dow Jones index closed up .76% for the day; a total of 190.87 points. The current value is 25,461.7. Apple Inc. ( AAPL ) had the largest percent change down (-2.84%) while International Business Machines Corporation ( IBM ) had the largest percent change gain rising 3.8%.
